findings.note: When a WARN is collected and a later predicate evaluation aborts, the resulting Evidence contains severity:"warn" entries with id dsl-warn-on-matched-capability but no severity:"block" summary for that id. REQ-004 and AC-056 explicitly prohibit WARN-only occurrences and require exactly one block summary whenever any WARN node exists.

A dependency failure partway through evaluation writes a semantically incomplete capability_evaluations array: the current or remaining Registry Capabilities are omitted because entries are appended only after completing a Capability. This conflicts with REQ-004's exact Registry-capability-set binding; the fixture validates only JSON-schema shape and therefore accepts Evidence that the specified semantic validator would reject.
